changes.title: Later quests
items: Sleeping legends now dream of creatures from deeper in the forest, further along the party's path
Every finished quest's buff is the same strength, however far you went for it

changes.title: Ko candles
items: Knocked down and back at her decks, a loading bar of candles along the desk's front shows her wait: a white candle for every second of it, red ones for the extra from being knocked down again soon after, burning down from the red end while she scratches, the last guttering out as she's back

changes.title: Needle drop
items: After the party spell the witch drops the needle and does a little scratching routine at her decks (baby scratches, chirps and a spin-back) before she can step off and the music drops
Knocked out and back behind her decks, she scratches through the wait, her hand thrown up as it ends
